Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Meze

94 reviews mention the meze. Guests write that the plates keep coming, and some take the leftovers home.

Weekend buffet

On Saturdays and Sundays lunch is a buffet: souvla, kleftiko, stifado, pastitsio, soups and desserts. 62 reviews mention the buffet.

Cypriot breakfast

Halloumi, anari and other cheeses, homemade jams, eggs, lountza, olives and fresh bread. 8 of the 220 reviews we read mention the breakfast.

Sweets and fruit

After the meal come fruit, orange pie, ice cream and other desserts. Some guests write that dessert was on the house.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

By the river

Tables above a small river, mostly under the trees, with a small waterfall. 8 of the 220 reviews we read mention the river.

Fireplace in winter

In the cold months a wood fire burns in the dining room. 4 of the reviews we read mention the fireplace.

Friendly service

52 reviews mention the polite staff. Guests also recommend booking ahead, as the tavern is popular.

A tavern among the trees

Potamos tis Militsas is in Kampi, in the mountains of the Nicosia district. Guests sit on a terrace under a reed roof, next to a stream of water and the trees, or inside by the fireplace. The tavern opens at 8:30 on most days, and at weekends lunch is a buffet.

What guests say

Three of 1,629 Google reviews, 1,476 of them with five stars.

“Fantastic hospitality, lovely atmosphere with the fireplace roaring, the delicious food kept coming and coming. They gave us complimentary soup and dessert. Everything was perfect! Will definitely be coming back to this authentic Cypriot restaurant in a serene environment.”
